name: g04-light
prompt:
ENG-G04 point-light shadows. Until now only the directional key light (lights[0]) casts shadows, through cascaded shadow maps (class kke::ShadowMap). Now each point light that casts shadows gets a cube of 6 faces around it (+X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z), each a perspective view a little wider than 90 degrees, drawn into its own tile of a second ShadowMap (the point map): tile = light * ShadowMap::kPointFaces + face. C++20, glm, Vulkan (depth 0..1, clip-space Y flipped by proj[1][1] *= -1.0f like computeLightViewProj). struct Light gets the point-shadow switch. Your SEARCH block is exactly these lines:
```
    float intensity = 1.0f;
};
```
and your REPLACE block is `    float intensity = 1.0f;`, then the new lines, then `};`. Change nothing else; do not copy or move any other line.
The new lines, in this order:
1. A two-line comment: point lights only: cast shadows (ENG-G04, ShadowMap::pointFaceViewProj) out to shadowRange metres from the light; six extra shadow passes per light, so it is off unless a game turns it on.
2. `    bool castsShadows = false;`
3. `    float shadowRange = 20.0f;`
4. A one-line comment: whether this light draws point shadows.
5. `    bool castsPointShadow() const { return enabled && !isDirectional && castsShadows; }`
